avis.titre: Refreshing, hydrating, and an instant mood‑liftRefreshing, hydrating, and an instant mood‑lift
avis.texte: Mario Badescu’s facial spray is one of those products that just gets it right. The mist is super fine, the scent is soft and clean, and it gives my skin that fresh, dewy boost without ever feeling sticky or heavy. I use it in the morning to wake my face up, before makeup for a smoother base, and throughout the day whenever I need a quick refresh. My skin looks brighter, feels calmer, and honestly — it’s become one of those little self‑care rituals I look forward to. Simple, effective, and always leaves me feeling a little more put‑together. Highly recommend.

avis.titre: This offers a lovely dose of refreshing hydration, but the spray bottle function is dreadful.
avis.texte: The product itself is a win for me. I'm in my 40's with combination, acne-prone skin, so I generally avoid heavy and/or cream facial moisturizers. I do, however, need some light hydration, especially on makeup days (before, during, & after application). This facial spray offers a lovely hydrating, refreshing facial pick-me-up any time of the day. It is definitely fragrant, so if someone avoids that in their facial products, this isn't for them, but I actually love the smell - a light rose scent (I always love anything rose-scented). The scent doesn't last long - I can't notice it after it dries or within a few minutes. While I don't think this is revolutionary or liable to change my skin in some big way, for the price, I'm happy with the quality and performance. One caveat that caused me to deduct a star - the spray function of the bottle itself is dreadful. It's the lousy spray quality I'd expect from something picked up at the dollar store. As one of the makeup artists I follow online would say, "She spits." That's the best way to describe this spray function - a random spitting sensation. In fact, the sprayer alone makes me hesitant to use this on top of makeup because the squirting is so spotty and heavy, I fear it might disrupt my makeup. Thankfully, I have a different empty facial spray mister bottle that works much better that I plan to transfer this product into. avis.texte: Personally, I love Mario Badescu's facial spray with aloe, herbs, and rosewater. It has a delicate rose scent that's fresh and relaxing without being overpowering. I like to use it in the mornings before applying makeup, after makeup for a more natural finish, and also during the day when my skin feels tired or dry. The mist is super fine and lightweight, leaves no sticky residue, and provides immediate hydration. My skin looks fresher and more radiant after using it. Plus, a little goes a long way, and the bottle is practical for carrying in your purse or keeping on your desk. It's not a miracle worker, but as a refreshing and hydrating spray, it does its job perfectly. I completely understand why so many people recommend it, and I would buy it again. ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐
